name: ffi_error
summary: Returns the most recent FFI error message for the current thread — for example the reason a ffi_load() returned 0 — or the empty string if there has been no error. Efuns on the FFI surface raise an LPC error on misuse; ffi_error() reports the failures that are signalled by a 0 return instead.

availability.condition: 需要 PACKAGE_FFI 和 libffi；WebAssembly 目标不可用
